description: This file defines the SupersetClientClass, a TypeScript class responsible for managing HTTP requests, CSRF tokens, and authentication handling within the Superset frontend. It includes methods for making GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests, handling CSRF token fetching, and managing unauthorized responses.

classes.name: SupersetClientClass
classes.description: A class that manages HTTP requests, CSRF tokens, and authentication for the Superset frontend.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SupersetClientClass with configuration options such as host, protocol, headers, and timeout.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes CSRF token, optionally forcing re-fetch.

methods.name: postForm
methods.description: Submits a form with given payload to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the client has a valid CSRF token indicating authentication.

methods.name: getGuestToken
methods.description: Returns the guest token if available.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request with specified configuration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request with specified configuration.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with specified configuration.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with specified configuration.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with given configuration, handles unauthorized responses.

methods.name: ensureAuth
methods.description: Ensures the client has a valid CSRF token, rejects if not.

methods.name: fetchCSRFToken
methods.description: Fetches a CSRF token from the server.

methods.name: getCSRFToken
methods.description: Returns the current CSRF token or fetches a new one.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL based on host, endpoint, and other parameters.
